1000463.etyen:

Compare Danish Amerika, Swedish Amerika, German Amerika, Dutch Amerika and English America (“America, the Americas”).

1005071.etyen: Internationalism, ultimately based on German Apraxie (“apraxia”), a medical term introduced in 1871 by Heymann Steinthal, from Ancient Greek ἀπραξία (apraxía, “inaction”), from ἀ- (a-, “not, without”) + πρᾶξις (prâxis, “action, doing”) + -ία (-ía, “abstract noun suffix”), literally “inaction”. The part πρᾶξις (prâxis) is related to πράσσω (prássō, “to do, act”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *per- (“to go through, cross”).
